grade_criteria.preliminary_association: Point estimate >= threshold but n<30 or CI lower bound below threshold.
grade_criteria.weak_or_contradictory: Survey dissatisfaction but independent indicator is relatively high.
grade_criteria.no_concern_detected: Bottom-box below threshold. Absence of a flag is not proof of adequacy.
